hooks.name: Demo Case Cache Checker
hooks.description: Checks fixtures/cases.json stays consistent with the comparator so demo cases produce stable Difference.signature cache keys. Read-only: never writes cache entries (Req 15/33: cache is written only after apply+verify).

action.prompt: fixtures/cases.json changed. Check it is consistent with the comparators so every demo case produces a stable Difference.signature cache key. Do NOT write or modify any cache file (apps/*/.cache.json or any other): per Req 15/33 the cache is written only by the orchestrator after apply+verify succeeds, and null proposed_change is never cached. For each case check: (1) id, domain, kind, target, context, expected_state are present and ids are unique; (2) kind is one the matching comparator emits (database: adapters/postgres/comparator.py; api: adapters/openapi/comparator.py; cache: adapters/redis/comparator.py); (3) target uses that comparator's target format (e.g. INDEX_MISSING target ix_<table>_<cols>, column kinds <table>.<column>); (4) context carries the fields the validator binds against (INDEX_MISSING: table, columns; TYPE_CHANGED: original_actual_type); (5) expected_state is consistent with the operation matrix in .kiro/steering/tech.md. Report a short table of cases with PASS or the specific problem. Do not modify cases.json, core/, any adapter, or the resolver.
